roster.reference: Cardiac ultrasound to explore the effects of chemotherapy on the heart (diagnostic trial)
roster.criteria: Inclusion criteria: Dogs diagnosed with any type of cancer that will receive doxorubicin-based therapy (e.g. CHOP, doxorubicine monotherapy, doxorubicine combi with carboplatin, ...) in consultation with a veterinary oncologist. Exclusion criteria: Patients receiving positive inotropic drugs, such as pimobendan, digoxin, theophylline, catecholamines... Patients that have had any type of chemotherapy (e.g. Palladia, …) before the inclusion to the study (prednisolone is allowed) (exception can be made for CHOP protocol - please contact study investigators) Patients with systemic hypertension or patients receiving medication to control this (e.g. ACEi, telmisartan, amlodipine…) Patients with hypothyroidism (will not standardly be tested before inclusion, only when clinically suspected) Patients with chronic kidney disease Patients with clinically significant echocardiographic abnormalities at the beginning of the study
roster.site: Faculty of Veterinary MedicineMerelbeke, Belgium
